sloka: सौमित्रिस्तु तथेत्युक्त्वा रथमारोप्य मैथिलीम् ।प्रययौ शीघ्रतुरगै रामस्याज्ञामनुस्मरन् ।। ७.४६.१२ ॥
transliteration: saumitristu tathetyuktvā rathamāropya maithilīm ।prayayau śīghraturagai rāmasyājñāmanusmaran ।। 7.46.12 ॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, having said "so be it," made Sita ascend the chariot and proceeded with swift horses, remembering Rama's command.
